Definition_EN: Composite index (0-100) published by ITU measuring universal and meaningful connectivity. It combines 10 indicators organized in two pillars of equal weight: Universal connectivity and Meaningful connectivity. New methodology since the 2023 edition; the year is the edition year and indicator values generally refer to two years earlier.

Pillar score (0-100) of the ITU ICT Development Index: average of normalized scores for 3G and 4G/LTE network coverage, mobile- and fixed-broadband Internet traffic per subscription, mobile data and voice and fixed-broadband basket prices, and individuals owning a mobile phone.

Pillar score (0-100) of the ITU ICT Development Index: average of normalized scores for individuals using the Internet, households with Internet access at home, and active mobile-broadband subscriptions per 100 inhabitants.
